item.text:
I can’t reliably certify a maximum-point schedule from this many overlapping windows and travel constraints without solving the optimization. I don’t want to present a plausible-looking schedule as optimal when it may not be.

If you can provide a solver output or allow this to be treated as a best-effort scheduling exercise rather than a guaranteed optimum, I can help format and check the schedule.
